Bet types on bet365 Sportsbook

It's very easy to wager on bet365, with a variety of bet types available for users to enjoy. Bet365 users can wager on popular markets with traditional bet types like moneylines, point spreads, and over-under totals. There is also the option to wager on more niche markets and betting lines with player props and parlays of all sorts.

Check out some of the popular bet types available for users on bet365:

  • Moneyline: Place a bet on either team to win the game. Favored teams will be marked with (-) odds, while underdog teams will carry (+) odds.
  • Point Spread: Place a bet on either team to cover the pre-game point spread (handicap). Favored teams will be giving (-) points, and underdog teams will be getting (+) points. A point spread bet that ends in a tie is considered a push, and the user is refunded.
  • Over-Under Total: Place a bet on the teams in the game to combine to score over or under the pregame set total. Over-under total bets that end in a tie are considered a push, and the user is refunded.
  • Player Props: Place a bet on individual players to reach specific statistical thresholds within a game. Player prop bets do not pertain to team win/loss result; they are strictly individual player-based.
  • Live Betting: Place a bet after a game has already started with updated odds. Live betting odds are updated from moment to moment to reflect the status of the game/match unfolding, and can provide massive points of value for live bettors.
  • Parlay: Combine multiple bets from different games onto the same ticket for multiplied odds. Each individual bet (leg) of the parlay must hit for the ticket to be cashed. If any of the individual legs are lost, the ticket is lost. If any of the individual legs end in a tie, they are considered a push and voided from the parlay ticket.
  • Same Game Parlay: Combine multiple bets from the same game onto the same ticket for multiplied odds. Each individual bet (leg) of the parlay must hit for the ticket to be cashed. If any of the individual legs are lost, the ticket is lost. If any of the individual legs end in a tie, they are considered a push and voided from the parlay ticket.
  • Futures: Place a bet on a future outcome, like a team to win a championship, conference, division, or record a certain number of wins throughout a season.
